summary: Iter 13 (Landing, Welcome, Legal, 14-day trial, yearly checkout, admin MRR panel) tested backend + frontend. 7/7 backend tests pass. Frontend verified end-to-end incl. real Stripe redirect. Found and fixed 1 critical bug (Layout.js referenced undefined `trialDays`) which was crashing all authenticated pages.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: `trialDays is not defined` at line 179. The trial banner block references a variable that was never declared/computed. This crashed the entire Layout, making Pricing, Admin, Dashboard, Invoices, Expenses, Contacts, Taxes, Connection, Settings all unrenderable (white screen). Fixed by computing trialDays from user.trial_ends_at.

action_items: Review the trialDays fix I applied in /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.js. My fix computes days remaining from user.trial_ends_at; confirm the UX copy is what you intended (banner appears on all pages during trial with 'Ver planes' upgrade link).
Consider adding a React ErrorBoundary around Layout so future undefined-var bugs don't blank the app.
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL: Layout.js `trialDays` reference was a showstopper. Any authenticated route crashed with white screen. Suggests this feature was added but the variable definition was missed. Recommend adding at least a smoke test that renders Dashboard after login.
Welcome page 'welcome-start' navigates to '/' which shows Dashboard. Works, but consider explicit navigate('/dashboard') pattern or ensuring first-run experience (empty state) is friendly.
Pricing.js hardcodes yearly = monthly * 10 for display; ensure this matches Stripe prices synced in stripe_service.sync_catalog (currently monthly*10, consistent).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 new features (Landing/, Register->Welcome with 14-day trial, /terminos + /privacidad, yearly toggle in /precios producing Stripe yearly checkout, /admin revenue panel) work. IMPORTANT: I fixed a bug in Layout.js (undefined trialDays). Verify main agent's follow-up matches intended trial banner UX. Backend endpoints validated: GET /api/plan returns trial plan, POST /api/payments/checkout with cycle=yearly returns checkout.stripe.com URL, GET /api/admin/revenue returns {mrr, arr, by_plan, altas_mes, trials_activos}.
rca of the issue: Layout.js referenced `trialDays` at line 179-183 without ever declaring it. Likely the author added the trial banner JSX but forgot to add the computation. React threw ReferenceError inside <Layout>, propagating up and rendering blank. Fix: computed trialDays = ceil((new Date(user.trial_ends_at) - Date.now())/86400000) when user is non-admin and trial not expired; null otherwise so banner is hidden.
